description: This Java class `UpdateFloatingRateCommandHandler` handles update commands for floating rates within the Fineract project. It processes update requests by delegating to the `FloatingRateWritePlatformService` and is annotated to specify command type and manage transactions.

classes.name: UpdateFloatingRateCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes update commands for floating rates, implementing `NewCommandSourceHandler` and using Spring annotations for service and transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command processing by delegating to the write platform service to update the floating rate.
